messages:
alex (infra): Looping you all in — vendor call with Cloud AM tomorrow re: our EDP renewal. Main asks: burst protection, clearer metering exports, and region-weighted pricing.

maria (finance): Quick numbers? what are we currently committed vs avg?

alex (infra): Current commit = 4000 A100-hours/month (us-west1 + eu-west3). 6mo avg = ~3600. Peaks hit ~5500 during heavy training windows. We need either carryover or a burst pool.

liam (cloud-sales): Vendor told me they prefer a larger single commit rather than fancy carveouts. Their initial counter for burst is paid overage only. They can offer 20% off overage if we increase commit by 15%.

raj (procurement): Let's avoid a hard bump without contractual guardrails. Proposed asks: (1) a dedicated "burst pool" with a discounted overage rate, (2) carryover of unused credits, (3) SKU-level daily usage export and a 60-90 day dispute window.

sre-bot: [billing-bot] ALERT: Invoice 2026-02 shows eu-west3 usage = 2,400h, our internal meter = 1,900h -> delta = 500h. Opening ticket BL-457.

maria (finance): That's material. Open a billing dispute + require daily CSV exports for reconciliation for the term of the EDP (or at least next 6 months). We need invoice adjustments if metering >0.5% discrepancy.

alex (infra): Negotiation playbook I'm suggesting to liam:
- Baseline commit: 3500h (committed, deep discount)
- Burst pool: additional 1000h/month at a mid-tier price (lower than pay-as-you-go)
- Overflow: pay-as-you-go for anything beyond baseline + burst
- Carryover: up to 10% unused baseline roll-forward for up to 3 months
- Metering: daily per-region per-SKU CSV + API endpoint; 60-day dispute window; adjustments on next invoice
- SLA: Metering accuracy >= 99.5% else billing credit

liam (cloud-sales): I raised the baseline/burst idea with AM. They countered: carryover max 5%, 30-day dispute window, 25% discount on baseline, 10% on burst pool. No long carryover beyond 1 month.

raj (procurement): Counter-proposal: 60-day dispute window, explicit invoice reconciliation process, and a credit multiplier for mis-metering >0.5% (e.g., 3x the dollar value of the miscounted hours). Also require per-SKU tags and exported metadata so our metering matches theirs.

maria (finance): From a finance POV we need the effective blended price for our expected usage to be below $1.50/GPU-hour (target). If vendor discounts don't meet that, we need to reconfigure commitments or look at spot/preemptible mix.

alex (infra): Also insist on region carveouts: guaranteed reserved capacity for critical clusters in at least two zones per region (minimum holdback for reserved workloads). If they can't guarantee capacity, we need automatic fallback to other regions with defined latency/egress terms.

liam (cloud-sales): Vendor willing to consider a zone-level carveout for a small premium, but asks for a minimum 12-month commit and explicit region weighting.

alex (infra): Draft clause for legal to consider (feel free to edit):

```
EDP Addendum - Burst Protection & Metering
1) Burst Pool: Up to 1000 GPU-hours/month available at Burst Rate (Baseline Rate * 1.10). Burst hours consumed beyond Burst Pool billed at PAYG.
2) Carryover: Up to 10% of unused Baseline hours may roll forward for up to 3 months.
3) Metering & Reconciliation: Seller provides daily per-region per-SKU usage CSV via secure API. Buyer has 60 days from invoice date to dispute usage. Invoiced adjustments will be issued within 30 days after resolution.
4) Metering SLA: Seller warrants metering accuracy >= 99.5%. For any month where accuracy < 99.5%, seller will credit Buyer at 3x the dollar value of the miscounted hours.
5) Capacity Guarantee: Seller will reserve minimal carveout capacity across two AZs per region to meet reserved throughput targets; failure triggers defined credits and right to burst to alternate region at capped egress rates.
```

maria (finance): That clause looks ok as a starting point. I'll model sensitivity for 5% vs 10% carryover and 30/60/90 day dispute windows and post numbers here.

raj (procurement): Also request contract language requiring meter exports for at least 12 months post-termination for auditing.

sre-bot: [calendar-bot] Meeting scheduled: 2026-03-02 10:00 PDT with Cloud AM & Solutions Engineer — invite sent.

alex (infra): Action items: @liam escalate to AM and ask for written confirmation of daily CSV + API access; @maria run sensitivity; @raj draft procurement addendum language; I'll prepare a short negotiation script and bring cluster utilization heatmap to the call.

liam (cloud-sales): Will do. Scheduling workaround if AM asks for exec-level signoff.

alex (infra): Thanks — keep this thread as the negotiation record. If anyone gets vendor emails, paste them here. :thumbsup:
